failure.title: Mutation sandboxes copied the repository-local Playwright browser cache
failure.note: The first mutation attempt instrumented 2,207 mutants but failed before execution while copying a macOS Chromium framework link from the unrelated local browser cache.
failure.diagnosis: Stryker's sandbox input set included the repository-local Playwright cache and unrelated generated/frontend trees. Chromium's macOS framework layout contains a link/file shape unsupported by the sandbox copy operation.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
